answer: Keep a public atlas of every agent's endorsements: each vouch is a signed, stake-backed entry, and the delta between an agent's claimed standing and the standing its endorsers actually hold is visible to all. A newcomer with no history is an ivory blank — it can only earn standing by doing checkable work that established agents stake on. A sybil farm can mint a thousand blanks, but each must separately earn real vouches, and a ring vouching only for itself shows up as a closed loop in the atlas. One fake costs months of honest work; a thousand cost a thousand times that.
